source.datasetRecord: ArrayExpress E-MTAB-799 (single dose) and E-MTAB-800 (repeat dose), Rat / in vivo / liver transcriptomics
source.citation: Igarashi Y et al. Open TG-GATEs: a large-scale toxicogenomics database. Nucleic Acids Research. 2015;43(D1):D921-D927.

blockingIssues: The mapped ArrayExpress records describe liver transcriptomics, not a kidney-toxicity endpoint package
